models.title: Terrain + water
models.purpose: Generate the full terrain and water structure around two planned bases.

inputs.name: Planned base heatmaps
inputs.source: User/test configuration supplies coordinates. Gaussian rasterization creates one channel per base.

inputs.name: Noisy terrain + timestep
inputs.source: Diffusion sampling starts with seeded Gaussian noise and repeatedly denoises it. During training, noise is added to source targets.

inputs.name: Terrain control vector
inputs.source: Ten normalized direct terrain controls + ten availability flags + water-enabled flag. Includes water fraction, relief, connectivity, front and bottleneck measurements.

outputs.name: Encoded terrain fields after diffusion sampling
outputs.source: At each timestep the U-Net predicts a velocity/denoising update; the sampler turns repeated updates into these final fields: asinh relative height, signed water distance (positive in water), log depth. These are not final native vertices.

training.target: Existing map height, water signed distance and water depth; not preview RGB.

models.not_outputs: Does not generate spawns, mexes, hydros, reclaim, texture painting or a playable map file.
models.caution: Control values steer predictions; they are not all guaranteed. Water finishing and symmetry are deterministic post-model steps.

arrays.name: profile (train.jsonl row)
arrays.role: Scalar condition: 10 values + 10 validity bits + water flag

raw_controls.note: Raw physical geometry; fit any scaling/presets on train only. No attack-lane count, resources or legacy economic openness.

training_evidence.objective: Source terrain is noised at a sampled timestep. The network learns a velocity update with base-weighted MSE, gradient and height/water-sign consistency terms. The scalar controls are conditions, not separate rating-prediction targets.
training_evidence.augmentation: Joint rotations/reflections and base-channel swaps. Scalar condition dropout is 15%, retaining the water-enabled flag.
training_evidence.unused: No mex/hydro fields, reclaim, texture, air/drop maps or gameplay ratings enter this selected terrain model.

models.title: Mexes + hydros
models.status_text: Markers exported and playtested; balance unproven
models.purpose: Learn resource marker locations from terrain and planned bases.

inputs.name: Aligned terrain and bases
inputs.source: Three encoded terrain fields + derived land/hover passability + two planned-base heatmaps.

inputs.name: Noise, timestep and count controls
inputs.source: Seeded diffusion noise, log mex count, log hydro count and water-enabled flag. Counts also limit the downstream peak decoder.

outputs.name: Resource heatmaps after diffusion sampling
outputs.source: The U-Net predicts velocity/denoising updates inside the sampler; final fields are mex/hydro scores, not coordinate lists. Exact counts are not reliably learned; the decoder caps the selected peaks.

training.target: Gaussian heatmaps rerasterized from exact source mex/hydro coordinates in active 1v1 configurations.

models.not_outputs: Does not predict commander spawn locations, terrain changes, props or building footprints.
models.caution: Current example decodes 32 mexes and 2 hydros. Terrain snapping, movement and flattening are intentionally disabled.

training_evidence.objective: Source mex/hydro targets are noised at a sampled timestep. Foreground-weighted velocity loss teaches resource score fields; the two count conditions are dropped on 10% of training batches.
training_evidence.augmentation: Joint rotations/reflections and base-channel swaps. Saved arrays are cached through float16 and converted to float32 by the loader.
training_evidence.unused: No air/drop maps, 1-5 gameplay ratings, reclaim or texture inputs. Counts are actual source marker counts, not resource-density ratings.

models.title: Trees + natural rocks
models.status_text: Latest visually preferred; composition seen in game
models.purpose: Learn where tree energy and natural-rock mass should be concentrated.

inputs.name: Terrain, bases and resources
inputs.source: The seven terrain/base channels plus mex and hydro fields. Aligned mean-pooling from 256 to 128; no reclaim target is an input.

outputs.name: Value-allocation heatmaps
outputs.source: The U-Net produces spatial logits; fixed spatial softmax yields tree-energy and natural-rock-mass shares. Each role sums to one; these are not entity counts or absolute amounts.

training.target: Unclipped extracted tree energy and rock mass, sum-pooled and normalized per map. High-value rocks contribute proportionally.

models.not_outputs: Does not choose assets, total mass/energy, exact prop coordinates, rotations, textures or wrecks. No neural noise input: same conditions give the same raw fields.
models.caution: Player preference selected latest, not best.pt. Lower source-agreement loss did not select the visually preferred result. Composer seed affects instances, not neural heatmaps.

training_evidence.profile_origin: None: no scalar profile is passed
training_evidence.objective: 0.5 spatial NLL + 2 Hellinger + 0.5 multiscale NLL. Only nonempty roles contribute, using the present mask. Targets are physical value divided by the per-map role total, not entity IDs or counts.
training_evidence.augmentation: Joint rotations/reflections and base-channel swaps. No diffusion noise or amount profile.
training_evidence.unused: Absolute tree-energy/rock-mass totals remain audit metadata, not neural conditions. No air/drop maps, ratings or textures.

models.title: Wreck / high-value reclaim
models.status_text: Pilot trained and exported; runtime not yet tested
models.cohort: 193 train / 18 validation; complete positive wreck mass only
models.purpose: Learn a separate mass-allocation field for enabled unit wreck reclaim.

inputs.name: Same terrain-and-marker packet
inputs.source: Same nine conditions as trees/rocks. Tree and rock predictions are NOT inputs. Feature weights were copied from the approved model only to initialize training.

outputs.name: Wreck-mass allocation
outputs.source: Spatial logits followed by fixed spatial softmax give relative wreck-mass shares. This does not decide whether a map has wrecks or how much mass they provide.

training.target: Known wreck mass only. Unknown-value maps excluded, not zero-filled. Known-zero maps do not supervise this conditional spatial role.

models.not_outputs: Does not output unit blueprint IDs, live units, tree/rock fields or exact wreck chunks. No neural noise input.
models.caution: Latest is a provisional export candidate. Only 18 held-out maps; visual/gameplay assessment is pending. Existing natural reclaim is preserved byte-for-byte.

training_evidence.profile_origin: None: no scalar profile is passed
training_evidence.objective: Spatial allocation loss on complete positive wreck-mass maps only. Known-zero maps do not supervise a spatial field. Unknown mass is excluded, not zero-filled.
training_evidence.augmentation: Joint rotations/reflections and base-channel swaps. Natural-reclaim feature weights initialize training; its predictions are not inputs.
training_evidence.unused: No tree/rock output fields, absolute wreck budget, blueprint IDs, air/drop maps, gameplay ratings or texture inputs.

models.title: Terrain texture painting
models.status_text: Extraction complete; no trained texture model
models.purpose: Eventually predict material painting that follows generated terrain and a chosen palette.

inputs.name: Proposed: terrain + material palette
inputs.shape: Terrain grids + 10 x 4 x 64 x 64 swatches / palette metadata
inputs.source: Input contract still to be finalized. Available palette data includes material paths, tiling scales, validity and RGBA swatches. Slots are not universal grass/rock labels.

outputs.name: Proposed: material painting
outputs.shape: Candidate: 9 x 256 x 256 weights / 8 paint masks
outputs.source: These images are extracted SOURCE targets, not generated outputs. Upper alpha and shader semantics require separate handling.

training.target: Raw mask samples, shader-derived weights, palettes, validity and diagnostic albedo extracted directly from SCMAP.

models.not_outputs: No generated texture output exists yet. Current in-game textures come from an inherited stock base material, not a learned texture model.
models.caution: 15 maps have unsupported paint semantics; only 929 fully resolve albedos. A decoded archive is not automatically a valid texture-training target.

models.title: Living civilian structures
models.kind: Standalone model pending; joint pilot uses the density target
models.status_text: Civilian density tensors ready; separate joint pilot running
models.cohort: 1,020 train / 97 validation; 217 maps with source civilians
models.purpose: Eventually learn where civilian buildings belong, separately from dead wreckage.

inputs.name: Proposed: terrain + bases/resources
inputs.source: Raw unit positions, IDs and army/allegiance are available from source extraction. A clean living-building training release still needs assembly.

outputs.name: Prepared source civilian count-density target
outputs.source: Recorded living civilian units/buildings, sum-preserving Gaussian rasterization. Standalone generation is not trained; the joint experiment predicts this channel.

training.target: Source civilian counts; not heterogeneous other props or potential wreck value. Runtime activation remains unresolved.

models.not_outputs: No standalone civilian generator or building-asset composer. The separate joint pilot includes civilian density among its outputs.
models.caution: Do not serialize living unit blueprints as generic SCMAP props.

models.title: Spawn layout (future)
models.kind: Approach undecided; not an existing model
models.purpose: Potential future stage to choose base locations instead of supplying them in the generation request.

inputs.name: Proposed: size + teams / layout request
inputs.source: A model vs deterministic selector has not been chosen. The current terrain model already requires the planned anchors before generation.

outputs.name: Current representation: base coordinates
outputs.source: Current example anchors are (96,256) and (416,256) on the native 512-world-unit grid. These are supplied inputs, not learned predictions.

training.target: Source spawn positions exist, but there is no dedicated spawn-layout training stage yet.

models.not_outputs: The resource network does not generate commander starts. No dedicated spawn-layout checkpoint exists; the separate joint pilot generates two start fields.
models.caution: Changing starts after terrain generation breaks the current conditioning contract; both stages must agree on the planned bases.

tools.name: Extract + audit
tools.input: Map folders: SCMAP, scenario/save/script Lua + blueprint archives
tools.output: Physical geometry, markers, typed entity/value records and material masks
tools.meaning: Reads source structure; previews are review aids, not the sole training data.

tools.name: Curate + split by family
tools.input: Extraction records + human exclusions + family/version evidence
tools.output: Frozen manifests; 1,020 train / 97 validation for the current main cohort
tools.meaning: Unreviewed means retained. Prefer selected FAF/latest versions. New role-specific exclusions do not delete maps from other roles.

tools.name: Role-specific tensor exporters
tools.input: Audited source arrays and entity values
tools.output: Aligned channel-first NPZ tensors + provenance and validity masks
tools.meaning: Train inputs and target outputs are separate arrays. Unknown values stay masked; coordinate pose and family split must match.

tools.name: Terrain finishing
tools.input: Three predicted terrain fields + requested symmetry/water settings
tools.output: Native 513 x 513 height vertices + coherent water + derived masks
tools.meaning: Decode, enforce full-map symmetry, reconcile water, smooth and quantize. Land/hover passability is derived, not a separate trained model.

tools.name: Resource symmetry + peak decoder
tools.meaning: Select peaks in symmetric pairs. Count caps and peak spacing are decoder rules, not evidence of perfect learned count calibration. No terrain repair.

tools.name: Tree / rock composer
tools.input: Two learned allocation fields + tree-energy / rock-mass budgets + asset pool + seed
tools.output: Actual native prop instances: blueprint, XYZ, yaw, scale, mass/energy accounting
tools.meaning: Budget areas use 8 x 8 cells; fine placement follows the 128-grid fields. Medium: 2,694 trees + 644 rocks. Low/medium/high add to the same instance streams. Report local shortfalls; never refill elsewhere.

tools.name: Wreck composer + runtime script
tools.input: Learned wreck field + mass budget + unit pool + seed
tools.output: Symmetric unit-wreck records + FAF CreateWreckage calls
tools.meaning: Current example: 18 wrecks / 4,943.52 mass. Uses 2 x 2 accounting areas and 4-world-unit wreck spacing. Explicit land-equivalent values, also underwater; no automatic water discount. Existing map and natural props are copied unchanged.

tools.name: Texture compiler (future)
tools.input: Future material fields + palette + shader contract
tools.output: SCMAP texture masks and material references
tools.meaning: No learned painting compiler is active. Current native writer clears old painted geography and retains a uniform inherited base material.

tools.name: Civilian composer (future)
tools.input: Future civilian layout + budgets / building pool
tools.output: Living unit/building save-Lua records and allegiance
tools.meaning: Separate from natural props and runtime wrecks. Target semantics and placement policy remain to be defined.

tools.name: Terrain / resource repair validator
tools.input: Marker positions + geometry + buildability / clearance rules
tools.output: Optional repaired positions / resource pads / warnings
tools.meaning: Implemented earlier, intentionally bypassed in current raw evaluation. Does not snap or relocate mexes/hydros/starts, flatten terrain, or filter reclaim on water.

tools.name: Native map assembly
tools.input: Native terrain, marker lists, composed props and scripts; inherited base material
tools.output: SCMAP + scenario/save/script Lua + preview PNG + metadata + install manifest
tools.meaning: Format and readback checks are active. MapGen Heatmap Medium 303 with 3,338 native props was explicitly judged playable by the expert player on 25 October 2026. First playable milestone achieved; competitive balance is unproven. Wreck additions still need runtime verification.

tools.name: Install + offline game check
tools.input: Export manifest and exact scenario path
tools.output: Installed map + launch log + human in-game feedback
tools.meaning: Installer checks hashes and refuses overwrites. The frozen MapGen Heatmap Medium 303 demo has an integrity-checking desktop launcher and shareable export. Player-confirmed playable milestone achieved on 25 October 2026; competitive balance remains unproven. Launcher refuses to interrupt an existing game.

experiments.generation_inputs: 13 x 256 x 256 Gaussian noise + timestep + 12 ratings; zero source spatial conditions
experiments.rating_representation: (score - 3) / 2; whole-rating dropout with a learned null embedding for CFG
experiments.training_targets: 13 x 256 x 256: height, depth, two starts, mex, hydro, natural energy/mass, wreck mass, civilian count density, RGB
experiments.masks: No spatial input or validity/exclusion masks; incomplete examples excluded before sealing; target-dependent foreground loss weighting
experiments.not_consumed: SDF, pathing, opportunity/front/access/economy grids, supplied anchors, blueprint IDs, texture masks or palettes
experiments.sampler: Seed, DDIM steps and CFG are sampler controls; training-range numerical bounds are recorded and raw final estimates saved
experiments.postprocessing: No gameplay repair, symmetry projection, count caps, budget composition or export

experiments.status: Research concluded with a negative full-generation result; historical experiment, no selected checkpoint
experiments.generation_inputs: Same thirteen noise channels, timestep, twelve ratings; zero clean source spatial channels
experiments.targets: Same thirteen source fields and frozen dataset encoding
experiments.objective: Baseline source weighting versus continuous source-activity balancing; no added analytical/input masks
experiments.controls: Controlled learning-rate comparison, sampling steps/CFG/clipping variants
experiments.caution: One-map fitting is memorization only. Lower-LR stability was observed through update 4971 in one controlled restart. Density totals remain incorrect.

terrain_fields.title: Water coverage
terrain_fields.meaning: Fraction of the decoded terrain occupied by water.
terrain_fields.caution: A learned request, not an exact percentage guarantee. Finishing preserves raw predicted SDF-sign area, not the requested percentage.

terrain_fields.title: Elevation range / relief
terrain_fields.caution: Relief is vertical amplitude, NOT local slope, cliff steepness or sharpness.

terrain_fields.title: Land connection between bases
terrain_fields.meaning: Whether the two planned bases belong to the same derived land component.
terrain_fields.caution: Training support must be checked; asking for an unseen setting is extrapolation.

terrain_fields.title: Total front width
terrain_fields.meaning: Median sum of cross-section widths in the central distance-phase band.
terrain_fields.caution: Terrain-only geometry. Not the earlier resource-attracted economic front_width score.

terrain_fields.title: Largest front opening
terrain_fields.meaning: Median largest connected span across the same central band.
terrain_fields.caution: A geometric span is not necessarily an independent strategic route.

terrain_fields.title: Persistent front fragmentation
terrain_fields.meaning: Fraction of sampled interior length with sustained multiple effective spans.
terrain_fields.caution: Related to split openings, but NOT an integer passage count or guaranteed number of attack lanes.

terrain_fields.title: Sustained bottleneck width
terrain_fields.meaning: Minimum sustained, window-averaged total cross-section width.
terrain_fields.caution: A width constraint learned statistically, not an explicit route-construction algorithm.

terrain_fields.title: Largest bottleneck opening
terrain_fields.meaning: Minimum sustained, window-averaged largest individual span.
terrain_fields.caution: Does not certify independent paths or unit-size clearance.

terrain_fields.title: Bottleneck severity / pinch
terrain_fields.meaning: One minus sustained bottleneck total width divided by typical front total width.
terrain_fields.caution: Higher means stronger relative contraction; must be consistent with the width requests.

terrain_fields.title: Length of the narrow section
terrain_fields.meaning: Longest run below the configured low-width threshold.
terrain_fields.caution: A terrain measurement, not travel time or a requested number of choke points.

questions.limit: Not exact. Water finishing preserves the generated water footprint's area rather than forcing the user's percentage.
Not the old economic openness rating. Several width and bottleneck values are coupled.

questions.where: Fragmentation and width conditions are related proxies
questions.limit: Requesting 'three passages' is not supported by this selected model's input contract.

questions.where: Relief changes height range; smoothing is a separate export setting
questions.limit: Neither relief nor a smoothing preset guarantees a particular local slope distribution.

questions.answer: Yes: model conditions AND decoder caps
questions.where: Two normalized count values + peak decoding
questions.limit: Raw score fields can overpredict. Exact decoded counts are not evidence of learned count accuracy.

questions.answer: Composer control, not a model input
questions.where: Physical energy/mass budgets after fixed allocation heatmaps
questions.limit: Changes instances and achieved totals, not the current deterministic model's allocation field.

questions.where: Available in the analysis dataset; an air summary scalar was used in some earlier models
questions.limit: Spatial air/drop influence maps and the full rating set are not fed into the four selected models.

runtime.name: Planned base coordinates
runtime.effect: Rasterizes the two spatial conditioning channels.
runtime.limit: Starts are supplied before geometry, not generated by this network.

runtime.name: Seed
runtime.effect: Changes initial Gaussian noise and therefore the sampled layout.
runtime.limit: A fixed seed alone is not a cross-machine reproducibility guarantee.

runtime.name: Guidance strength (CFG)
runtime.effect: Changes how strongly conditional predictions differ from the null-control prediction.
runtime.limit: Stronger is not necessarily more correct; it can introduce artifacts. Probe default is 1.5.

runtime.name: Sampling steps
runtime.effect: Changes the number of iterative denoising updates; probe default is 100.
runtime.limit: Not a training epoch count, and not a specific terrain-shape request.

runtime.name: Symmetry mode / projection
runtime.effect: Enforces a chosen symmetry on full-map fields or native geometry.
runtime.limit: Current example uses 180-degree rotation. This is not learned symmetry conditioning.

runtime.name: Smoothing preset
runtime.effect: none / light / medium selects native-grid smoothing sigma 0 / 2 / 4 with coast protection.
runtime.limit: A deterministic height edit, not a trained sharpness parameter; default finishing is light.

runtime.name: Mex count / hydro count / water enabled
runtime.effect: Profile changes generated heatmaps; counts also cap the decoder.
runtime.limit: Example export uses 32 mexes and 2 hydros. Counts are not density ratings from the scientific scoring pipeline.

runtime.name: Resource seed / steps / guidance
runtime.effect: Changes marker heatmap sampling without retraining terrain.
runtime.limit: Keep base locations and native geometry consistent with the condition packet.

runtime.name: Peak threshold / spacing / symmetry
runtime.effect: Changes which heatmap maxima become actual marker pairs.
runtime.limit: Can reduce the output count. No terrain snapping or resource-pad repair is applied in the current raw export.

runtime.name: Tree energy / natural-rock mass budgets
runtime.effect: Scales physical target values while retaining the neural allocation fields.
runtime.limit: Tree mass is additional to rock mass and is included in total reclaim accounting.

runtime.name: Composer seed / asset pool
runtime.effect: Changes concrete blueprint variants, within-field positions and yaw.
runtime.limit: Does not change the deterministic neural heatmaps.

runtime.name: Budget-area grid / spacing / entity cap
runtime.effect: Changes local value accounting, center-spacing rejection and safety limits.
runtime.limit: 8x8 budget areas and zero spacing in the approved example. Unmet budgets remain local.

runtime.name: Wreck-mass budget / unit pool / seed
runtime.effect: Turns a fixed wreck-allocation field into selected unit wrecks.
runtime.limit: No abundance scalar or seed is supplied to the deterministic wreck network.

runtime.name: Wreck spacing / area grid / safety cap
runtime.effect: Controls physical instance spacing and budget quantization.
runtime.limit: Current export uses 2x2 areas, 4-unit center spacing, and explicit land-equivalent values even underwater.
